sentences.text: An AI agent says it "remembers" you — architecture, or a slogan?
sentences.text_raw: An AI agent says it "remembers" you — architecture, or a slogan?

sentences.text: The independent claim is a five-step loop: query in, memory data from a datastore of your past interactions, both into a sequence model, answer out.
sentences.text_raw: The independent claim is a five-step loop: query in, memory data from a datastore of your past interactions, both into a sequence model, answer out.

sentences.text: Memory is its own box, not a longer prompt.
sentences.text_raw: Memory is its own box, not a longer prompt.

sentences.text: So what sits in that box?
sentences.text_raw: So what sits in that box?

sentences.text: Not a transcript.
sentences.text_raw: Not a transcript.

sentences.text: A memory object is a container: one or more memory values — a string, an image, audio — plus metadata such as a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, and a summary of the conversation it came from.
sentences.text_raw: A memory object is a container: one or more memory values — a string, an image, audio — plus metadata such as a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, and a summary of the conversation it came from.

sentences.text: Who decides what gets stored?
sentences.text_raw: Who decides what gets stored?

sentences.text: A model does.
sentences.text_raw: A model does.

sentences.text: Cached inputs go to the model, which predicts whether anything is worth remembering, extracts that portion, and writes it as a memory value.
sentences.text_raw: Cached inputs go to the model, which predicts whether anything is worth remembering, extracts that portion, and writes it as a memory value.

sentences.text: Your "remember this" is one trigger, and the write can run offline.
sentences.text_raw: Your "remember this" is one trigger, and the write can run offline.

sentences.text: At query time the agent does not reread everything.
sentences.text_raw: At query time the agent does not reread everything.

sentences.text: A recall cycle scores stored objects for relevance to the query, using embedding distance such as cosine similarity, and returns a top subset.
sentences.text_raw: A recall cycle scores stored objects for relevance to the query, using embedding distance such as cosine similarity, and returns a top subset.

sentences.text: Values come ordered by timestamp, so the model sees recency.
sentences.text_raw: Values come ordered by timestamp, so the model sees recency.

sentences.text: Memories can be corrected.
sentences.text_raw: Memories can be corrected.

sentences.text: New timestamped input is matched to a prior memory object and then either replaces it or updates it.
sentences.text_raw: New timestamped input is matched to a prior memory object and then either replaces it or updates it.

sentences.text: Aligned objects can be consolidated into one.
sentences.text_raw: Aligned objects can be consolidated into one.

sentences.text: So contradicting information refines a memory instead of noisily overwriting it.
sentences.text_raw: So contradicting information refines a memory instead of noisily overwriting it.

sentences.text: Can it forget?
sentences.text_raw: Can it forget?

sentences.text: "Forget that" deletes that information from the datastore.
sentences.text_raw: "Forget that" deletes that information from the datastore.

sentences.text: "Forget this after three months" queues it for deletion, and objects past their expiration time are cleared in a maintenance cycle.
sentences.text_raw: "Forget this after three months" queues it for deletion, and objects past their expiration time are cleared in a maintenance cycle.

sentences.text: The same chat that builds the memory erases it.
sentences.text_raw: The same chat that builds the memory erases it.

sentences.text: What is the memory for?
sentences.text_raw: What is the memory for?

sentences.text: The model first generates an analysis of your query against the memory data, and that analysis is never shown on screen.
sentences.text_raw: The model first generates an analysis of your query against the memory data, and that analysis is never shown on screen.

sentences.text: The response itself can be an API call, so memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.
sentences.text_raw: The response itself can be an API call, so memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.

sentences.text: There are no benchmark numbers in this filing.
sentences.text_raw: There are no benchmark numbers in this filing.

sentences.text: What it claims is structural: memory objects built from your own interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you say so.
sentences.text_raw: What it claims is structural: memory objects built from your own interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you say so.

sentences.text: That is an architecture on paper, not a slogan.
sentences.text_raw: That is an architecture on paper, not a slogan.
